title: Ætheric Public Distribution System: A Blockchain and AI-Driven Framework for Transparent Food Grain Distribution

contributions.purpose: 为印度公共配给系统(PDS)提供防篡改、可互操作的分发框架
contributions.mechanism: 整合私有以太坊链记账 + Bharat Stack API(Aadhaar 认证/UPI 支付)+ RFID/NFC 粮食追踪 + AI 库存预测 + Flutter 移动端
contributions.evaluation: 无量化实验;仅定性声明四项评估维度(透明/可扩展/准确/互操作),并推测可省 20-30% 泄漏
contributions.domain: 区块链 + 电子政务 / 粮食安全供应链
contributions.source_quote: This paper introduces the Ætheric Public Distribution System (ePDS), a novel framework that integrates blockchain with Bharat Stack APIs, enabling interoperability with Aadhaar for beneficiary authentication and UPI for secure transactions.

contributions.purpose: 以模拟原型证明框架可行性
contributions.mechanism: MVP 模拟五个组件:RFID 粮袋追踪、mock Bharat Stack 的 Aadhaar 验证、私有以太坊交易记录、AI 月度库存预测、Flutter 应用
contributions.evaluation: 自认 MVP 全靠模拟、缺真实 PDS 环境的实证验证;未报告任何性能/准确率数字
contributions.source_quote: The prototype simulates: 1. RFID-tagged grain tracking from warehouse to shop. 2. Aadhaar verification using mocked Bharat Stack APIs. 3. Blockchain transaction recording using a private Ethereum network.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Against this backdrop, the proposed Ætheric PDS distinguishes itself by explicitly addressing interoperability, real-time monitoring, AI forecasting, and user accessibility, thereby extending beyond the conceptual limitations of existing research.
Compared to prior works, ePDS advances hybrid models by emphasizing cross-chain agents, offering greater potential for nationwide PDS reform.

notes: desk-reject;协议适配问题:纯系统提案/概念验证文,evaluation 一栏无任何数字,'评估'章节只列四个定性维度;'20-30% leakage savings'为无依据推测而非实测。自认局限:MVP 全模拟无实证、Aadhaar 隐私未解、gas 费与能耗未量化。无 Agents4Science AI 参与 checklist(正文未含),无法核对 AI 自我披露。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+intro 归纳 2 条。
